command:
set -e
source ../reconcile-tooling/activate.sh
export LEAN_CC="$PWD/scripts/lean-cc.py"
export LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE=false
export LEAN_SYSROOT="$(lean --print-prefix)"
pnpm typecheck
node --import tsx scripts/build.ts
lake build --wfail
node --harmony-temporal --import tsx scripts/check-lean.ts
pnpm test
pnpm exec fallow --changed-since HEAD --fail-on-issues
pnpm exec eslint src/serialization/facets/collection.ts src/parse.ts src/stringify.ts src/__tests__/serialization.spec.ts src/__tests__/serialization-collections.spec.ts scripts/check-lean.ts scripts/check-serialization-collection-runtime.ts
pnpm exec ls-lint --config .ls-lint.yaml
pnpm exec prettier --check scripts/check-serialization-collection-runtime.ts src/__tests__/serialization-collections.spec.ts lean/Serialization/COLLECTION.md research/serialization/COLLECTION-FOLD.md
pnpm exec vitest --no-watch --config vitest-library.config.ts src/__tests__/serialization.spec.ts src/__tests__/serialization-collections.spec.ts src/__tests__/sparse-codec.spec.ts
node /tmp/collection-fold-bundle.mjs
node --harmony-temporal research/serialization/scalar-wire-review/check.mjs "$PWD/lib/neutral/index.js" A
node --harmony-temporal research/serialization/scalar-wire-review/check.mjs "$PWD/../reconcile-codec-artifacts/collection-fold-both.mjs" A
git diff --check
